_template_note: Mirror of the dispatch spec produced by tools/research_os/executor_contract.build_dispatch_spec(action). The OS sends this to an executor (Codex, WorkBuddy, another agent or a script). The executor fills the RETURN contract (research-os/executor-return/0.1) — it must NOT edit this spec, raise any claim ceiling, assert a positive finding, or mark the episode complete. Replace <...> placeholders.
success_failure_evidence: executor must return explicit success/failure with exact source identities and calculation results; absence of evidence is failure.
prohibited_claims: executor must not raise any claim ceiling
executor must not assert a positive finding
executor must not mark the episode complete
stop_condition: return when the bounded objective is met or a budget/blocker is reached; never self-approve.
